claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the treatment restores damaged, dry, or breaking hair, often describing dramatic improvement after use.
Several reviewers note the hair becomes hard or stiff after applying and blow drying, which they describe as normal and temporary.
Some reviewers mention an unpleasant smell, though long-time users say they are accustomed to it.
A few reviewers report only mild or limited results, including one who found it made hair only slightly softer.
One reviewer reports the product was missing from the package.
